profile.name: A2D数据采集模块
profile.description: 这是一款实验室用数据采集设备，具备模拟电压读取、温度测量和数字输入/输出功能，并带有板载指示灯与可配置通道。它适合用于传感器信号采集、基础电压监测、数字控制和通用实验自动化测试。
profile.description_en: This is a laboratory data acquisition device with analog voltage readback, temperature measurement, and digital input/output capabilities, along with an onboard indicator LED and configurable channels. It is suitable for sensor readout, basic voltage monitoring, digital control, and general laboratory automation tasks.

registry.name: A/D DAQ
registry.description: A/D DAQ Module是由A/D Instruments生产的表征设备，主要功能包括初始化、参数配置、复位、日志记录、校准、测量。支持Signal, Slot, conf io等操作。
